query: For finite measures `μ, ν` on `α`, finite kernels `κ, η : Kernel α β`, with `μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ μ ⊗ₘ η`, the Radon–Nikodym derivative of `μ ⊗ₘ κ` with respect to `ν ⊗ₘ η` (as measures on `α × β`) is, almost everywhere with respect to `ν ⊗ₘ η`, equal to the product `p ↦ (dμ/dν)(p.1) · (d(μ ⊗ₘ κ)/d(μ ⊗ₘ η))(p)`.
